items.q: But it changed the style a little bit when Louie Bellson came in to play drums and Willie Smith came in and Duke let him make a few arrangements, you see, --

ctx.x: He looked at us, you know. And from that night on that was it. The band cooked. But it changed the style a little bit when Louie Bellson came in to play drums and Willie Smith came in and Duke let him make a few arrangements, you see, --
